Singulus Technologies Aktiengesellschaft: Triumph Signs Agreement with European Investor to Sell Its Stake
Disclosure of Inside Information pursuant to Article 17 MAR
Triumph Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd., China, Signs Agreement with European Investor to Sell Its Stake in SINGULUS TECHNOLOGIES AG - Subject to Approval by the Relevant Governing Bodies

Triumph Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd., China, ("Triumph"), informed the company today that approximately 1.5 million shares (approx. 16.75%) held by Triumph are to be sold to a European investor. According to the information provided, the relevant agreement has been signed by both parties and is now subject to approval by the relevant government authorities in China.
